I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the next renewal at Brackenwater Freight Co. is on **25 November**.

Ilse posted that date in #north-team on 14 October, and nothing posted in the channel since then changes it. I checked first that Marcus is a member of #north-team, so this is a message he can already see. A renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the account's team.
